programme.title: J Music 2026 (音乐2026年)
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry. (J音乐致力于创建高质量的音乐平台,为歌手提供展示其音乐天赋的机会,同时让音乐迷能够更深入地了解其音乐故事。这个节目邀请流行歌手作为嘉宾,亲自选择其最喜欢的新旧作品,现场演出,并分享其最喜欢的曲目。音乐场面的新面孔也将出现,通过互动交流展示其音乐潜力。此外,每集都密切关注《玉实金图》的最新发展,包括音乐视频和与各种歌手、作曲家和制作者的访谈,他们讨论他们的工作以及音乐行业内的人与活动。)

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information. (香港是全球烹饪的熔炉。 食物锚和东道主如黄卡梅尼、 黄卡门、 吴嘉明、 吴吉良等,不断了解最新的烹饪趋势,收集各平台上顶级餐厅的信息,主播亲自抽样食物,提供诚实的检讨,发现不同区藏有的宝石,邀请长期外雇人员访问他们最喜爱的家乡菜园知名厨师和食品批评者,也引导他们走上道路,提供专家建议。 节目特别选取了《食品新闻报告》中热门的餐厅,突出他们的签名盘子,提供快速交易,确保观众了解最美味、最廉价的餐饮信息。)

programme.title: Tai Hang Yao
programme.desc: In 1939, during the harsh anti-Japanese war in the Taihang Mountains, Eighth Route Army soldiers were unable to care for their newborn children due to brutal battlefield conditions. Led by Wang Sanping, local village women from the Womens Rescue Association stepped up, risking their lives to raise and protect the soldiers infants. Facing constant enemy threats, these women forged a deep bond with the military through incredible sacrifice and bravery.

programme.title: Mr.Player
programme.desc: Jacky Wu leads a team of celebrity guests through energetic missions staged in different destinations. The players compete in creative games, physical challenges and surprise tasks that test teamwork, strategy and humour.

programme.title: Flavor of Life
programme.desc: After leaving a successful but unfulfilling career, Han-Shiao reopens her familys beloved bistro to rebuild her life and reconnect with her loved ones. As old romances return, hidden family secrets emerge, and three generations of women face love, sacrifice, forgiveness, and new beginnings.

programme.title: I Believe ((我仍然相信))
programme.desc: Chu Chu has been waiting for her first love for 10 years but he marries someone else in the end. As she loses faith in love, she meets a wedding planner and a handsome and rich man, who both help her get over her ex-boyfriend. As Chu Chu feels the same love from them, she must make up her mind. Who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Love is the only Answer ((人约离婚后))
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: Operation Mekong ((湄公河行动))
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Band Four (第四乐队)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music. (在她母亲去世后,一个叫Band Four的独立乐队的一位有抱负的歌手与她离散的吉他手父亲团聚。 与其同父异母的姐姐和9岁的儿子一起,新团聚的家庭聚集在一起,通过对音乐的爱和热情相互支持。)

programme.title: Z Storm ((反贪风暴))
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk is on the case of a corrupt policeman but finds all key witnesses killed when he starts to discover some clues. As investigation continues, Luk uncovers the fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the governments 15 billion Care Fund. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: The Locksmith ((锁匠))
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: Triad ((三生花))
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang. (这是关于香港三合会的故事。 钟·威廉·陈。 张德里克·赞和东·爱德华·楚伊是童年的朋友,他们一起加入三合会。 但是,在加入后,他们发现名声和财富最终将粉碎他们,因为他们中只有一人能够成为黑帮头目。)

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire ((我和僵尸有个约会))
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Sky on Fire ((烈焰焚城))
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Silent Code ((沉默代码~监狱的密约~ - 百度百科))
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem... (兰记者的任务是研究互联网新闻, 并穿越BBS热门论坛,梦想董事会。论坛创始人项项为网民分享梦想和想法创造了空间, 但最终却因视频泄露而成为激烈辩论的主题。 兰记者为真相挖掘真相时, 她发现事情比看上去复杂得多。)

programme.title: Inner Senses ((异度空间))
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface. (由于被过去的创伤所带来的反复出现的视觉困扰,求精神科医生吉姆医生恢复她的头脑和克服她的烦的过去.然而,随着逐渐康复,吉姆发现自己被同样的令人不安的图像困扰,因为他的压抑的记忆重新浮出.)

programme.title: Caught In Time ((除暴·独家纪录片))
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Smashing Frank ((捣破法兰克))
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves Frank, their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game. (四个戴着兔子面具的年轻盗贼把抢劫者从富人身上拉出来。 弗兰克(Frank)自称“弗兰克 ”, 他们的任务不是金钱,而是通过涂鸦和视频视频揭露腐败。 然而,当他们与参与洗钱计划的强大教会串通时,他们的任务就变成了一场致命的游戏。)

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900 ((唐探1900))
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: As It Burns ((白昼如焚))
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhens childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate ((龙门飞甲))
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News ((OMG! 阿妈有喜))
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads (53岁的丽塔及其丈夫正计划退休,当她发现自己意外怀孕,结束平静的家庭生活,在混乱和欢笑中为婴儿做准备时,他们在爱和接受方面学到深奥的教训。 正如和平回来一样,丽塔学习胎儿可能患有唐氏综合症,面对她终极十字路口。)

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo ((山忌：黄衣小飞侠))
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Customs Frontline ((海关战线))
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home. (香港海关官员发现在国际冲突相关的货运船上非法武器.)

programme.title: Last Song For You ((久别·重逢))
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journeyher parting gift to reignite his life. (夏天,年轻的Xia和Su为他们的音乐爱而纠缠在一起,想知道这种爱能带他们走多远。 几年后,音乐家Su Suu突然与他的初恋Xia在最黑暗的时间内在医院里团聚。 悲哀的Xia和Su看到自己的内心斗争,最后的旅途礼物是离开苏,重现他的生活。)

programme.title: Shes Got No Name ((酱园弄·翻案))
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star ((星际钝胎))
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other. (一个漂亮但无知的女人被外星人绑架,但没有人相信她的近距离遇见. 计划自杀以证明自己,她遇到了一个失败的侦探,他也计划自杀. 他们在发现彼此后改变了他们的想法,开始遇到奇怪的冒险,然后爱上彼此.)

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow ((徐老虎与白寡妇))
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung ((龙虎会风云))
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shihs magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires. (的英雄是银幕原始功夫女士之一,Shih Szu,她扮演剑女孟洪.她必须与洛莱赫饰演的Fan Tien-Fu合作,寻找和保护王朝的皇家.的壮丽表演让她获得了另一个成功的女英雄角色.)

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants ((欢笑老弄堂))
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile ((飞龙斩))
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom? ((女校春色))
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Gamblers Delight ((流氓千王))
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off! (杀手明星丹尼·李扮演一个需要成为英雄的男人的主角. 他撒谎,偷窃和欺骗自己运营一个豪华的场,)

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie ((花街时代))
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on. (年轻的梅丽在万市工作为酒吧女生,以谋生.当她在酒吧里遇到吉米时,她认为他是她的真正爱人,并疯狂地爱上他.当吉米必须离开时,梅丽很丧.直到她遇到三人团的老板,她终于找到了一个可以依靠的人.)

programme.title: Swordswomen Three ((江湖三女侠))
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans. (虎,隐藏龙可以被称为剑女二.三十年前,沈,埃西林奇亚和潘英曾担任了肖的第一名国际超级明星,洛莱赫为汉家族剑 - 这使得这成为动作粉丝的四星级盛宴.)

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister ((乾隆皇君臣斗智))
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again. (英明的帝国学士刘勇总是以其敏锐的智慧和格言使忠龙皇帝难堪。 皇帝特意安排他解决看似无法解决的问题。 然而,刘勇以智慧和风格轻而易举地解决问题,再次挫败皇帝的阴谋。)

programme.title: The Master ((大师))
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase ((钓金龟))
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments. (剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧)

programme.title: Oath Of Death ((万箭穿心))
programme.desc: Three Sung loyalists become blood brothers to fight the tyranny of the Tartar invaders. To oust the oppressors altogether, Ma releases the kidnapped Tartar princess in a strategic effort to gain points with the invaders, but it soon becomes apparent that he desires both a great position and power, and will do anything to get it

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion ((八国联军))
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing. (女皇西西认为拳击手声称他们开发了一种对武器不易使用的功夫,从而对八个外国国家的联盟宣战.清政府缺乏武器和良好的领导力使八个国家联盟能够击败北京.)

programme.title: Gossip Street ((多嘴街))
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious... (周围的邻居都聚集在八楼的第二层! 居民大多数是来自各个阶层的普通人,)

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude ((椰林春恋))
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Bells of Death ((夺魂铃))
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion ((我为你狂))
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back (花芳是一位执着的男人,他爱他的妻子阿霞,但很容易嫉妒和虐待她。有一天,当她离开他时,她和另一个女人Hsing勾搭了另一个女人Hsing。当她再次进入阿霞并决定赢回她时,一个致命的三角关系就会发展出来。)

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor ((教头))
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Passing Flickers ((三十年细说从头))
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado! (这部电影是香港电影行业的有趣的内幕人士看,基于导演李汉希安的热门报纸专,讲述了他在肖兄弟的作品.)

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind ((七煞))
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys? (王宫命令部长将他们推到部,并从内部拆散.随着更多内部冲突发生,)

programme.title: The Merry Wife ((娃娃夫人))
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute! (一位17岁的女学生娶了她35岁的老师。喜剧在他们试图将关系秘密化时出现,尽管他们在同一所学校。 当他们发现那些不想要的求婚者追求另一半时,嫉妒有可能随时暴露他们的婚姻!)

programme.title: King Eagle (王)
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lins sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Fast Fingers ((梁上君子))
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bills nieces! (比尔叔叔从监狱获释后,回来与过去的伙伴们一起发财。 他们继续利用那些不知情的公众,但受到正直的警察局长的密切监视,他恰好是比尔斯叔叔侄女之一的男朋友!)

programme.title: Nesam
programme.desc: Nathans loan rejection from a bank leads him to pursue a romantic relationship with the daughter of the bank manager, but his intentions are discovered, resulting in unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Krack
programme.desc: When 3 notorious criminals lock horns with a hot-tempered police officer, Potharaju Shankar, little do they know that they will end up behind bars.

programme.title: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
programme.desc: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

programme.title: Deiva Machan
programme.desc: Karthi is guided by visions of a man on a white horse as he strives to arrange his sisters marriage. However, an ominous prophecy soon unfolds, bringing unexpected troubles his way.

programme.title: Mirugaa
programme.desc: Forest officials in Kotagiri hunt a man-eating tiger that is attacking innocent people. At the same time, a serial killer is on the prowl for wealthy single women.

programme.title: Thamizharasan
programme.desc: A disgruntled police officer takes control of a hospital after the hospital staff neglect his ailing son. Eventually, conflict arises after he refuses to follow a direct order from his senior.

programme.title: Meymarandhen Paaraayo
programme.desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Vijay, replaces him just before his brother is set to be crowned as the king. Princess Maithili falls in love with Prem.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Ace
programme.desc: Kannan moves to a foreign country seeking life, but gets dragged into shark circle. A heist turns hope into a curse, forcing him to outsmart fate.

programme.title: Bhola Shankar
programme.desc: In Kolkata, a taxi driver fights to build a new life with his sister, but his dark past catches up with him as he battles the citys dangerous underworld.

programme.title: Idhu Kathirvelan Kadhal
programme.desc: Kathir, who hates marriage, is in Coimbatore to resolve a family dispute. There, he falls for Pavithra but his heart is broken when he discovers that she is in love with someone else.

programme.title: Maaman Magal
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation about her husband, a woman seeks a divorce, but then discovers she is pregnant, leading to a difficult decision.

programme.title: Rekka
programme.desc: A young man, known for helping couples elope, is forced by a gangster to kidnap a politicians daughter after he stops the wedding of a girl who didnt want to marry him.

programme.title: Desingu Raja
programme.desc: Idhyakani falls for Bindu Madhavi despite their families rivalry. The lovers try to unite them, but their efforts lead to a conflict between the families.

programme.title: U-571 ((猎杀U-571))
programme.desc: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival. (电影以第二次世界大战的真实事件为灵感, 讲述了美国潜艇船员的任务, 捕获一艘携带Enigma代码机的德国潜艇. 这是一部充满欺骗,危险和生存的紧张,水下动作惊喜片.)

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets ((北极解密))
programme.desc: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.desc: 武术教头夏侯武因错手杀人沦为阶下囚，却在狱中敏锐察觉到一场针对全港武林高手的连环杀戮他凭神准预判命案成功赢得女督察陆玄心的信任，破格出狱协助调查与此同时，先天残疾却武痴成狂的封于修四处血腥挑战各路宗师随着杀戮疯狂升级，两位绝世武者终将迎来轰烈对决

programme.title: 女人心
programme.desc: 有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

programme.title: 中华英雄
programme.desc: 1913年，华英雄惨遭灭门，愤然流亡美国妻子洁瑜怀孕寻夫，二人异乡重逢孰料龙凤胎出生当夜，中华楼遭敌纵火，洁瑜惨死女婴被掳十六年后，子华剑雄踏上寻父之路，华英雄则于自由女神像顶，与宿敌无敌展开生死决战

programme.title: 师兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 该片描述董骠调查制造毒品案，却惨死在毒贩枪下董骠化做鬼魂回警察局，借警员周星驰之手查清杀己的凶手冯淬帆和周星驰在茅山老祖的指导下利用灵药合力斗败邪恶法师，枪毙邓公子，为董骠报了仇，使他能安心上天堂

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: 西游记大结局之仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 在月光宝盒引发的混乱之后，至尊宝被卷入时空之中，并逐渐觉醒为孙悟空的真实身份在凡人情感与天命之间不断拉扯，他努力在对紫霞仙子的爱情与肩负的使命之间作出艰难抉择

programme.title: 神话
programme.desc: 考古学家杰克因神秘梦境的指引，揭开自己前世身为大将军蒙毅，与异国公主玉漱有一段跨越千年的凄美爱恋当两人在秦始皇陵天宫重逢之际，为夺取长生秘密的财阀尾随而至杰克重拾前世战力，与强敌展开一场跨越千年的宿命对决

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道长与徒弟隐居于偏远村庄某日，玛利亚修女计画重建一座荒废已久的教堂，却意外唤醒沉睡多年的僵尸黑袍传教士全镇顿时陷入恐慌，面对传统茅山术失效的绝境，一眉道长唯有与西方驱魔神父联手，融合中西驱魔之法，展开一场惊心动魄的驱魔大战

programme.title: 伤城
programme.desc: 屡破奇案的凶杀组总督察刘正熙的富豪岳父惨遭谋杀，刘正熙太太因对警方的调查进展产生怀疑，请来丈夫昔日的生死之交私家侦探丘建邦调查真相随着调查不断深入，案情峰回路转，丘建邦最终发现案件竟与刘正熙有着千丝万缕的关系

programme.title: 韩城攻略
programme.desc: 特工林贵仁隶属日本国防外务科特别侦缉组，他与一名飞贼联手，试图窃取两块美金伪钞电版然而，当电版被美国大使馆人员盗走并带到韩国后，整个事件变得更加复杂棘手

programme.title: 七小福
programme.desc: 本片是改编自京剧大师于占元师傅的真实故事六十年代戏剧文化日渐衰落，但于师傅仍坚持要保留他的戏剧学院三个少年决意入读于师傅的戏剧研究学院，向他拜师学艺，经过艰辛的训练过程后，于师傅终于成功造就香港影坛这三大巨星

programme.title: 表错七日情
programme.desc: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情

programme.title: 错爱迷踪
programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小说家，两人一见钟情感情迅速升温原来女孩已悄然落入惊天迷局，全因小说家的前女友是个毁容的女鬼，她借用人面还魂复仇，与前男友联手开启夺命惊吓

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘

programme.title: 神勇双妹唛
programme.desc: 故事描述一对表姐妹梁山伯与祝英台乃斗气冤家，两女为争夺神秘俊男阿山欢心，却惹来大圈杀手威吓逼害，更陷入一场宝物争夺战两女身陷险境，惟有摒弃前嫌，联手反抗

programme.title: 青面修罗
programme.desc: 年轻刺客青面修罗接受人生首份刺杀任务，同时暗中调查当年自己家族灭门惨案幕后起因但任务还未完成，他发现自己已经卷入了一场策划多年的阴谋当中，唯有利用自己的刺客技能，一一破局

programme.title: 求爱敢死队
programme.desc: 失恋的王晶认识了电台节目主持曾志伟志伟自诩情场杀手向王晶提供追求秘诀，但当其本身周旋于妻子与情人的关系当中，却不知如何是好...

programme.title: 倒数回击
programme.desc: 天才拳击手徐佳阳为了替父亲还赌债在地下酒馆打黑拳时被举报，痛失奥运资格赛，陨落拳坛十年后，铁血教练陈丽月决要助她实现父亲的遗愿，重回拳坛找回昔日的自己当拳击的热血碰上责任时，曾经失落的拳击梦能否再度燃烧？

programme.title: 审死官
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演著名状师宋世杰，经常不择手段为富人打赢官司，让他们逍遥法外，因此妻子迫使他退隐乡间然而，当宋夫人结识一位丈夫之死被贪官掩盖的妇人时，宋世杰决定挺身而出，再次在公堂上伸张正义，为她讨回公道

programme.title: 烈探
programme.desc: 警探张荼为救落入人贩之手的儿子，不惜孤身深入敌穴，跨国追击，但却被牵扯进大型儿童拐卖案在寻找儿子的过程中，他和身份神秘的女子携手捣毁了一个大型国际犯罪集团，上演了一场惊心动魄的绝地生死营救

programme.title: 百变星君
programme.desc: 富家子李泽星挂名留学，实际上却挥金如土，并自命情圣，称霸校园一日，因搭上黑帮老大情妇Silvia，而遭黑帮刺杀，被炸得粉身碎骨这个财大气粗的李泽星以百变金刚之姿态复活，还掌握了独特的能力，得到一份真正的工作，还有他真心爱上的意中人

programme.title: 盲战
programme.desc: 在多年前的一次反恐任务中，前特警队长东谷被悍匪炸瞎双眼，被迫退役，从此与女儿相依为命不料，昔日宿敌再度现身，绑走其女，欲将她卖入地下人口贩卖集团这位失明的法外独行侠，凭藉过人的听觉与格斗本领，只身踏上营救女儿之路

programme.title: 真情部落格
programme.desc: 节目透过访问的方式，让各个生命勇士讲述当他们面对自己生命中的难题时，选择靠着信靠耶稣来勇敢胜过，这些可爱的基督徒们，愿意把自己生命里最黑暗软弱的一面和大家分享，为的就是将来自天上那最美好的福分带给人们，每一个有血有泪的生命见证，都是最震撼人心的蜕变，最深刻的真实

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第2集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第20集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第35集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第25集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第17集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全张颕康饰，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace冯盈盈饰深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如陈敏之饰的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第8集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第17集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第29集
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第30集

programme.title: 大酱园 第27集
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第8集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第17集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 状王之王 第1集
programme.desc: 满清年间，聪敏机灵的宋世杰王浩信饰因父亲宋安张达明饰是名狱吏，从小就游走于牢房内，见尽世间不平之事，令他不相信法律有公义世杰长大后亦不愿进官场，纵有真才实学，也只暗中相助同试考生何守信林子聪饰中举，他则偕兄弟宋阿九金刚饰浪游天下世杰及后却被卷进蜘蛛精杀人案中，他为寻真凶展示状师才华，期间更结识了武功高强的青楼护卫玲珑姚子羚饰案件了结，世杰和玲珑结为夫妻，他亦正式踏上状师之路，还接连遇到一宗宗错综复杂的大案

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Cocomelon Dan Sahabat
programme.desc: Cocomelon merupakan seri animasi yang menceritakan kehidupan sehari-hari JJ, saudara-saudaranya, dan teman-temannya dalam dunia yang cerah dan penuh warna. Melalui lagu, permainan, dan petualangan sederhana, mereka belajar tentang keluarga, sopan santun, angka, huruf, serta nilai-nilai moral seperti tolong-menolong dan kasih sayang.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Bernard Bear
programme.desc: Bernard Bear adalah sebuah animasi pendek ber-genre serial televisi anak-anak. Animasi ini menceritakan tentang Bernard, seekor beruang kutub, yang selalu sial di setiap episodenya akibat ulahnya atau tokoh lain

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Pada Zaman Dahulu
programme.desc: Pada Zaman Dahulu adalah serial animasi yang mengangkat kisah fabel rakyat Melayu, terutama kecerdikan Sang Kancil. Cerita berpusat pada Aki yang menceritakan dongeng kepada dua cucunya, Aris dan Ara, yang tinggal bersamanya di kampung. Animasi ini mengandung nilai moral, nasihat kehidupan, dan hiburan.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Kiko
programme.desc: Animasi Kiko mengisahkan petualangan Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang mandiri dan riang, bersama empat sahabat setianya: Lola ikan diskus, Ting Ting kepiting, Patino ikan patin, dan Poli ikan cupang. Mereka menjalani berbagai kisah seru dan memecahkan masalah di bawah laut.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Entong
programme.desc: Animasi Entong adalah anak laki-laki Betawi berusia 10 tahun yang cerdas, saleh, dan ceria. Ia tinggal bersama ibunya, Fatimeh, di sebuah perkampungan setelah ayahnya meninggal. Kisah ini mengikuti petualangan harian Entong, persahabatannya, serta persaingannya dengan anak-anak lain seperti Memet.

programme.desc: KanienkhaWhen a reserve is threatened, its up to the Dreamcatchers to save the day!But they cant recruit their Dreamer until he finishes his homework,forcing the team to battle an evil bulldozer all by themselves.Can they recruit their Dreamer.

programme.title: Inuktitut Warrior Up!
programme.desc: Inuktitut, South Baffin At just 20 years old, law student Sophia Sidarous is a veteran land defender and water protector who has led many protests. Now shes safeguarding Mikmaw land from encroachment and travelling back to her community.

programme.title: Inuktitut Ajungi!
programme.desc: Inuktitut, South Baffin Inuk Elder July Papatsie teaches Donovan Gordon-Tootoo how to make a small inukshuk, a stone figure of great significance in Inuit culture. Inukshuks help Inuit hunt, communicate, navigate the Arctic landscape and more.

programme.title: Kanienkha Princesses
programme.desc: Kanienkha The most beautiful thing about a woman is her power to bring a new life into the world. We are now seeing a modern revitalization of Indigenous traditions around birth and motherhood.

programme.title: Kanienkha Working It out Together
programme.desc: Kanienkha This episode takes Team Firestarters to the great outdoors. The team learns how to have a healthier relationship with food. Waneek introduces them to Zumba and Jonas opens up about his sexuality.

programme.title: Kanienkha One Dish, One Spoon
programme.desc: Kanienkha Still grieving, Tawnya pushes through exhaustion to cater the Sapling Flint Winter Market, feeding her community and remembering her mothers impact.

programme.title: Cree Indians and Aliens
programme.desc: Cree Legends of the sasquatch have been deeply entrenched in British Columbia lore for several centuries. Ernest Webb meets with Kelsey Charlie, a respected StsAiles community member who describes his face-to-face encounter with a sasquatch deep.

programme.title: Cree Pow Wow Chow
programme.desc: Cree, Swampy With most of his crew MIA on set-up day and still in a walking boot, Bob finds himself needing a hand from Shawn and Whitney as the Rama Competition Pow Wow is set to kick off a jam-packed weekend.

programme.title: Michif Mtis Foodies
programme.desc: Michif, Heritage Suzanne and Paulette visit the Houle family in Calgary, where they celebrate the legacy of legendary fiddler Teddy Boy Houle. Through music, food, and family stories, they honour Mtis tradition and the bonds that keep it alive.

programme.title: Michif Chaos and Courage
programme.desc: Michif Meet the Indigenous women at the Boyle McCauley Health Centre and Hope Mission in Edmonton, who serve the citys most vulnerable residents, providing them with basic needs like meals as well as medical, rehabilitative and spiritual services.

programme.title: Salish Warrior Games
programme.desc: Salish Host Steve Sxwithultxw learns how to play snow snake, a sport played by Eastern Woodlands communities in Ontario and the Dene Nation in Northern Canada. It involves throwing a wooden javelin as far as possible along a track of snow.

programme.title: Nisgaa Ocean Warriors: Mission Ready
programme.desc: Nisgaa As Gitxaala Nations Ocean Warriors search for a diver who has failed to return to his boat, the Kitkatla community celebrates the repatriation of cultural artifacts. These sacred treasures bring new hope and fresh insight.

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker
programme.desc: Mikmaq Shawn travels just south of Edmonton to Ermineskin Cree Nation, a community thats one of four Maskwacis Tribal Council Nations. He meets with Jaime Copenace, a local chef and youth programmer who shows him how to make a moose meat stew.

programme.title: APTN National News Weekend
programme.desc: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

programme.title: Mikmaq Spirit Talker
programme.desc: Mikmaq Shawn heads northeast of Edmonton to Saddle Lake Cree Nation and learns the duties of being an apprentice stickman for a community round dance. A woman who is leery of communicating with the spirit world gets a wakeup call during a reading.

programme.title: Kanienkha Ghost Hunters of the Grand River

programme.title: Kanienkha Ghost Hunters of the Grand River

programme.title: Cree Unsettled Spirits
programme.desc: Cree, Plains Amanda Quill and her team investigate reports of a dark, heavy presence at Funky Winker Beans, a downtown Vancouver dive bar.

programme.title: Cree Unsettled Spirits

programme.title: Cree Unsettled Spirits
programme.desc: Cree, Plains Amanda, Nathan and Kayla are called to investigate neighbouring businesses in downtown New Westminster, where owners are experiencing a haunting presence in their workplaces. Both business owners need help.

programme.title: Cree Indians and Aliens
programme.desc: Cree Francois Paulette, a respected Dene Elder, describes being chased by a massive UFO on a lonely highway in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Cree Indians and Aliens
programme.desc: Cree Ernest Webb travels to the Arizona desert, a land where legends are still alive and well. There, he meets with Jon Dover, an ex-Navajo Ranger and law enforcement officer. He tells Ernest about a night spent filming strange aircraft over the.

programme.title: Cree Squamish Medium

programme.title: Cree Squamish Medium

programme.title: Mikmaq Gespegewagi: The Last Land
programme.desc: Mikmaq Migmaq fishing guides prepare for the 2019 salmon season at the Kedgwick Lodge. The Kedgwick River used to be full of salmon, so we learn what the Listuguj science team is doing to increase the salmon population in the river.

programme.title: Mikmaq Gespegewagi: The Last Land
programme.desc: Mikmaq Adam Jerome is part of an aquaculture team in Gesgapegiag that farms sugar kelp. Together, they are tapping into a multi-billion-dollar industry, developing delicious products and creating economic self-sufficiency for their community.

programme.title: Kanienkha Princesses
